recognition.what: AnythingLLM: Open-source local-first personal AI agent platform
recognition.why: Provides an all-in-one open-source desktop runtime that runs personal AI agents locally on user hardware. Gives users complete local ownership of agent memory, documents, and tool executions with zero cloud lock-in, advancing the goal of personal interface autonomy.
recognition.title: GitHub - Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm: Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with AnythingLLM.
